model_description: Uniform independent observation and plant errors on the registered robust support; induced transition law depends on state.
paper_assumption_1_scope: state-conditioned transition law induced by uniform observation and plant errors
stopping_semantics: terminal states absorb before any disturbance is applied, for both stochastic models

strong_stochastic_baseline.proof_scope: Same modeled support, candidate and domain as the source robust result; does not certify real-camera probabilities.
strong_stochastic_baseline.logical_implication: If B(next)<=B(now) for every disturbance in the same support, then E[B(next)|state]<=B(state) for every probability law on that support. No uniformity or independent-coordinate assumption is needed.

interpretation_of_inconclusive: An incomplete standalone interval integration is not failure of a stochastic method; a matching robust certificate already implies its nonincrease expectation condition.
strict_comparison_warning: Zero plateaus and absorbing terminal states can make strict epsilon impossible for this transferred candidate; this is not evidence that SPVC cannot synthesize a different certificate.
certificate_obligations: Numerical drift results alone do not establish unsafe separation, reliable arithmetic, real visual distribution validity, or all closure/terminal assumptions.
arithmetic: float64 interval operations; no directed outward rounding
witness_significance_guard: drift lower must exceed relative tolerance times (1+|B|+|E upper/lower|); smaller positive drift is never used as a counterexample. Acceptance is not relaxed by this tolerance.

task_metadata.comparison: controlled backend, frozen current visual interface/controller; not native retraining
task_metadata.arithmetic: float64 interval arithmetic; no directed rounding
task_metadata.frontend_execution: state proxy plus bounded semantic residual
task_metadata.coordinates: axis x then y, each [p,v,s,r] physical SI units
